entities.name: SMPD1
observations: Encodes acid sphingomyelinase (ASM), studied for effects on regulatory T-cell balance and induction.

entities.name: Regulatory T cells
observations: ASM deficiency or inhibition is associated with increased Treg frequency; evidence includes in-vitro induced Treg generation but does not establish thymic development effects.

entities.name: PMID:27638864
observations: Mouse ASM deficiency and amitriptyline treatment increased Treg frequency; increased proportion may partly reflect conventional T-cell loss, while Tregs showed greater resistance to inhibitor-associated death.

entities.name: PMID:29908119
observations: ASM-deficient T cells showed increased induced Treg output in vitro under TGF-β and IL-2; supports restraint of peripheral induced-Treg generation, not thymic development.
